title: About Us — Utsah Events | Bardoli, Gujarat
description: Learn about Utsah Events — our story, our team, and our passion for creating magical celebrations in Bardoli, Gujarat.
headExtra:
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;0,500;0,600;0,700;1,300;1,400;1,600&family=Cinzel:wght@400;500;600;700;800;900&family=DM+Sans:wght@200;300;400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="/style.css?v=85">
<style>
    /* ===== ABOUT PAGE SPECIFIC ===== */
    .about-page { position: relative; z-index: 2; }

    /* Logo — maroon on this page */
    .nav__logo-img {
      filter: sepia(1) hue-rotate(-45deg) saturate(6) brightness(0.55) !important;
    }
    .nav__logo { cursor: pointer; }
    @media (min-width: 431px) {
      #nav { transition: opacity 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) !important; }
      #dropdownBtn { transition: opacity 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); }
    }
    @media (max-width: 430px) {
      .nav { pointer-events: all !important; }
      .nav__logo { pointer-events: all !important; display: block; }
    }

    /* HERO */
    .about-hero {
      min-height: 100vh;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      text-align: center;
      padding: 100px 40px 60px;
    }
    .about-hero__label {
      font-family: var(--body);
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: 5px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: #FFD700;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }
    .about-hero__title {
      font-family: 'Cinzel', serif;
      font-size: clamp(2.4rem, 6.5vw, 5.5rem);
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #ffffff;
      line-height: 1.0;
      margin-bottom: 0;
    }
    /* Desktop only — matches the Times New Roman treatment on the home
       hero. Scoped above the tablet breakpoint so phone/tablet keep
       their existing Cinzel untouched. */
    @media (min-width: 1025px) {
      .about-hero__title { font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; }
    }
    .about-hero__title span { color: var(--maroon); }
    .about-hero__sub {
      font-family: var(--body);
      font-size: clamp(1.1rem, 2vw, 1.35rem);
      color: #ffffff;
      max-width: 560px;
      line-height: 1.8;
      font-weight: 700;
      margin-top: 12px;
    }
    .about-hero__scroll {
      margin-top: 24px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      color: #FFD700;
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: 3px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }
    .about-hero__scroll-star {
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      line-height: 1;
      color: #c9a84c;
      text-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(201,168,76,0.8), 0 0 20px rgba(201,168,76,0.4);
      animation: scrollPulse 2s ease infinite;
    }
    @keyframes scrollPulse {
      0%, 100% { opacity: 0.4; transform: scaleY(1); }
      50% { opacity: 1; transform: scaleY(1.15); }
    }

    /* STORY SECTION */
    .story {
      padding: 48px 40px;
      max-width: 700px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 36px;
      text-align: center;
    }
    .story__images {
      position: relative;
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 1000px;
      height: 420px;
      border-radius: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: all 0.7s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
      z-index: 10;
    }
    .story__images.expanded {
      position: fixed;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      width: 100vw !important;
      max-width: 100vw !important;
      height: 100vh !important;
      z-index: 9999;
      border-radius: 0;
    }
    .story__slide {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background-size: cover;
      background-position: center;
      opacity: 0;
      transition: opacity 1.2s ease;
      border-radius: 20px;
    }
    .story__slide.active { opacity: 1; }
    .story__content { }
    .story__label {
      font-family: var(--body);
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 4px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--maroon);
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }
    .story__title {
      font-family: var(--heading);
      font-size: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3.2rem);
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #ffffff;
      line-height: 1.15;
      margin-bottom: 28px;
    }
    .story__text {
      font-family: var(--body);
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      line-height: 1.9;
      color: #ffffff;
      font-weight: 600;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

    /* VALUES — single cycling card */
    .values {
      padding: 32px 24px;
      max-width: 400px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      text-align: center;
    }
    .value-single {
      border-radius: 20px;
      padding: 28px 24px 44px;
      text-align: left;
      position: relative;
      height: 200px;
      color: #ffffff;

      /* Translucent frosted surface — maroon-tinted */
      background: linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(120,15,15,0.3) 0%, rgba(20,5,5,0.25) 100%);

      /* Creates a distinct, physical glass edge */
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2);

      /* Double box-shadow: outer shadow for depth, inset shadow for edge illumination */
      box-shadow:
        0 12px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.25),
        inset 0 4px 12px rgba(255,255,255,0.15);

      /* Standard glassmorphism fallback + layer initialization */
      backdrop-filter: blur(4px) saturate(140%);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(4px) saturate(140%);
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    /* Isolate and apply the liquid distortion map on its own layer */
    .value-single::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      border-radius: inherit;
      z-index: -1;
      pointer-events: none;
      backdrop-filter: url(#liquidGlass);
    }
    .value-slide {
      position: absolute;
      top: 28px;
      left: 24px;
      right: 24px;
      opacity: 0;
      transition: opacity 0.7s ease;
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    .value-slide.active {
      opacity: 1;
      pointer-events: auto;
    }
    .value-card__icon {
      font-size: 1.4rem;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
      color: #FFD700;
      text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(255,215,0,0.8), 0 0 22px rgba(255,215,0,0.5);
      display: block;
    }
    .value-card__title {
      font-family: var(--heading);
      font-size: 1.5rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #ffffff;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }
    .value-card__text {
      font-family: var(--body);
      font-size: 0.88rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: #ffffff;
      line-height: 1.7;
    }
    .value-dots {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 16px;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      display: flex;
      gap: 6px;
    }
    .value-dot {
      width: 5px;
      height: 5px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
      transition: background 0.4s;
    }
    .value-dot.active { background: var(--maroon); }

    /* TEAM SECTION */
    .team-section {
      padding: 48px 40px;
      max-width: 900px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      text-align: center;
    }
    .team-section__label {
      font-family: var(--body);
      font-size: 0.72rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: 6px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: #FFD700;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }
    .team-section__title {
      font-family: var(--heading);
      font-size: clamp(3rem, 7vw, 6rem);
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #ffffff;
      line-height: 1.0;
      margin-bottom: 60px;
    }
    .team-section__highlight { color: var(--maroon); }
    .team-title-line {
      display: block;
      transition: transform 0.9s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1);
    }
    .team-title-line--left { transform: translateX(-70px); }
    .team-title-line--right { transform: translateX(70px); }
    .team-section__title.visible .team-title-line--left,
    .team-section__title.visible .team-title-line--right {
      transform: translateX(0);
    }
    .team-section__title:hover .team-title-line--left { transform: translateX(-10px); }
    .team-section__title:hover .team-title-line--right { transform: translateX(10px); }
    .team-grid {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 32px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }
    /* Minimal card — photo + name + role only */
    .team-card {
      cursor: pointer;
      width: 200px;
      text-align: center;
      background: none;
      border: none;
      transition: transform 0.3s;
    }
    .team-card:hover { transform: translateY(-6px); }
    .team-card__photo {
      width: 160px;
      height: 160px;
      object-fit: cover;
      object-position: center center;
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: block;
      margin: 0 auto 16px;
      border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
      transition: border-color 0.3s;
    }
    .team-card:hover .team-card__photo { border-color: var(--maroon); }
    .team-card__photo--initial {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--maroon), #cc2200);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-family: var(--heading);
      font-size: 3rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #ffffff;
    }
    .team-card .team-card__name {
      font-family: var(--heading);
      font-size: 1.6rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      color: #ffffff;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
      letter-spacing: -0.5px;
    }
    .team-card__role {
      font-family: var(--body);
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      font-style: normal;
      letter-spacing: 3px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: #FFD700;
    }
    .team-card__hint { display: none; }
    .team-hint-single {
      font-family: var(--body);
      font-size: 0.68rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75);
      letter-spacing: 2px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      text-align: center;
      margin-top: 20px;
    }

    /* Popup overlay */
    .team-popup-overlay {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      z-index: 20000;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      opacity: 0;
      visibility: hidden;
      transition: opacity 0.3s, visibility 0.3s;
    }
    .team-popup-overlay.open {
      opacity: 1;
      visibility: visible;
    }
    .team-popup {
      border-radius: 24px;
      padding: 48px 40px;
      max-width: 480px;
      width: 90%;
      min-height: 460px;
      text-align: center;
      color: #ffffff;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: center;
      transform: translateY(20px) scale(0.97);
      transition: transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1);

      /* Translucent frosted surface — maroon-tinted, matches hamburger menu glass */
      background: linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(120,15,15,1) 0%, rgba(20,5,5,1) 100%);

      /* Creates a distinct, physical glass edge */
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2);

      /* Double box-shadow: outer shadow for depth, inset shadow for edge illumination */
      box-shadow:
        0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.5),
        inset 0 4px 12px rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
    }
    /* Photo fills the entire card as a soft, blurred backdrop */
    .team-popup__photo {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
      object-position: center top;
      filter: brightness(0.6) saturate(110%);
      transform: scale(1.01);
      border-radius: 0;
      margin: 0;
      border: none;
      z-index: 0;
    }
    /* Light scrim over the photo so text stays legible, without going opaque black */
    .team-popup::before {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      z-index: 1;
      background: rgba(20,5,5,1);
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    /* Isolate and apply the liquid distortion map on its own layer */
    .team-popup::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      border-radius: inherit;
      z-index: 1;
      pointer-events: none;
      backdrop-filter: url(#liquidGlass);
    }
    .team-popup-overlay.open .team-popup {
      transform: translateY(0) scale(1);
    }
    .team-popup__close {
      position: absolute;
      top: 16px; right: 16px;
      width: 32px;
      height: 32px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      background: rgba(0,0,0,0.45);
      backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
      border: none;
      border-radius: 50%;
      color: #ffffff;
      font-size: 1.2rem;
      cursor: pointer;
      line-height: 1;
      z-index: 3;
      transition: background 0.2s;
    }
    .team-popup__close:hover { background: rgba(0,0,0,0.7); color: #fff; }
    .team-popup__name {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 2;
      font-family: var(--heading);
      font-size: 2rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #fff;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }
    .team-popup__role {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 2;
      font-family: var(--body);
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 2.5px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: #FFD700;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
    }
    .team-popup__divider {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 2;
      width: 50px;
      height: 1px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
      margin: 0 auto 24px;
    }
    .team-popup__bio {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 2;
      font-family: var(--body);
      font-size: 1rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: #ffffff;
      line-height: 1.85;
    }

    /* CTA */
    .about-cta {
      position: relative;
      max-width: 760px;
      margin: 40px auto 100px;
      border-radius: 20px;
      padding: 36px 32px;
      text-align: center;
      color: #ffffff;

      /* Translucent frosted surface — maroon-tinted */
      background: linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(120,15,15,0.399) 0%, rgba(20,5,5,0.399) 100%);

      /* Creates a distinct, physical glass edge */
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2);

      /* Double box-shadow: outer shadow for depth, inset shadow for edge illumination */
      box-shadow:
        0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.35),
        inset 0 4px 12px rgba(255,255,255,0.15);

      /* Standard glassmorphism fallback + layer initialization */
      backdrop-filter: blur(4px) saturate(140%);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(4px) saturate(140%);
    }
    /* Isolate and apply the liquid distortion map on its own layer */
    .about-cta::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      border-radius: inherit;
      z-index: -1;
      pointer-events: none;
      backdrop-filter: url(#liquidGlass);
    }
    .about-cta__title {
      font-family: var(--body);
      font-size: clamp(0.9rem, 1.4vw, 1.1rem);
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #ffffff;
      letter-spacing: 1px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      margin-bottom: 40px;
      line-height: 1.4;
    }
    .about-cta__sub {
      font-family: var(--body);
      font-size: 0.88rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: #ffffff;
      letter-spacing: 1px;
      margin-bottom: 28px;
    }
    .about-cta__btn {
      display: inline-block;
      padding: 12px 36px;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.95) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.8) 100%);
      backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.6);
      box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.9), 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
      color: var(--maroon);
      font-family: var(--body);
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 2.5px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      border-radius: 100px;
      text-decoration: none;
      transition: transform 0.2s, opacity 0.2s;
    }
    .about-cta__btn:hover {
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      opacity: 0.9;
    }

    /* Scroll reveal — visible by default, animated when JS class present */
    .reveal { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
    .js .reveal {
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(28px);
      will-change: opacity, transform;
      transition: opacity 0.75s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1),
                  transform 0.75s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1);
    }
    .js .reveal.visible {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: none;
      will-change: auto;
    }
    /* Stagger helpers */
    .reveal[data-delay="1"] { transition-delay: 0.08s; }
    .reveal[data-delay="2"] { transition-delay: 0.16s; }
    .reveal[data-delay="3"] { transition-delay: 0.24s; }
    .reveal[data-delay="4"] { transition-delay: 0.32s; }

    /* Desktop: show all 3 value cards as a grid, no cycling */
    @media (min-width: 431px) {
      .values {
        max-width: 1000px;
        padding: 40px 40px;
      }
      .value-single {
        height: auto;
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
        gap: 20px;
        background: none;
        backdrop-filter: none;
        -webkit-backdrop-filter: none;
        border: none;
        box-shadow: none;
        padding: 0;
        position: static;
        overflow: visible;
      }
      .value-slide {
        position: relative;
        opacity: 1 !important;
        pointer-events: auto;
        border-radius: 8px;
        color: #ffffff;

        /* Translucent frosted surface — maroon-tinted */
        background: linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(120,15,15,0.499) 0%, rgba(20,5,5,0.499) 100%);

        /* Creates a distinct, physical glass edge */
        border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);

        /* Double box-shadow: outer shadow for depth, inset shadow for edge illumination */
        box-shadow:
          0 20px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12),
          inset 0 4px 12px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);

        /* Standard glassmorphism fallback + layer initialization */
        backdrop-filter: blur(4px) saturate(140%);
        -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(4px) saturate(140%);

        padding: 28px 24px;
        transition: transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1), box-shadow 0.4s;
      }
      /* Isolate and apply the liquid distortion map on its own layer */
      .value-slide::after {
        content: "";
        position: absolute;
        inset: 0;
        border-radius: inherit;
        z-index: -1;
        pointer-events: none;

        /* Triggers a modern rendering context to allow backdrop distortion */
        backdrop-filter: url(#liquidGlass);
      }
      .value-slide:hover {
        transform: translateY(-8px) scale(1.07);
        z-index: 3;
        box-shadow:
          0 28px 55px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2),
          inset 0 4px 12px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4);
      }
      .value-dots { display: none; }
    }

    /* Responsive */
    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      .story { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 40px; padding: 60px 24px; }
      .story__images { height: 300px; }
      .values__grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .team-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    }

    /* ===== PHONES (≤430px) — iPhone 14/15/16, Pixel, Galaxy S ===== */
    @media (max-width: 430px) {
      /* Hero — exactly full screen, stats start right after */
      /* 100svh (small viewport), not 100vh (large viewport) — vh resolves
         taller than what's actually visible while Safari's bars are
         expanded, which was pushing the bottom-anchored star below the
         visible fold until the user scrolled. */
      .about-hero { height: 100svh; min-height: unset; padding: 100px 20px 0; }
      .about-hero__label { font-size: 0.62rem; letter-spacing: 2px; margin-bottom: 6px; }
      .about-hero__title { font-size: clamp(1.7rem, 7vw, 2.1rem); }
      .about-hero__sub { font-size: 0.85rem; margin-top: 12px; max-width: 100%; line-height: 1.6; }
      /* Scroll cue — star + "Scroll" label pinned to the bottom of the hero.
         100svh anchors it to the small-viewport bottom so it stays visible
         while the browser bars are expanded. */
      .about-hero { position: relative; }
      .about-hero__scroll {
        margin-top: 0;
        position: absolute;
        /* Bottom-anchored (not top: calc(100svh - Xpx)) so the star sits a
           fixed distance from the hero's true bottom edge regardless of
           its own height — the old top-offset was sized for star+label and
           left a dead gap once the label was removed below. */
        bottom: max(24px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
        /* centered via left/right + align-items, not translateX — the reveal
           animation overwrites transform when it finishes */
        left: 0;
        right: 0;
        transition: opacity 0.35s ease;
      }
      /* "Scroll" label removed on mobile — star only, matching desktop */

      /* Story */
      .story { padding: 40px 20px; gap: 24px; }
      .story__images { height: 240px; border-radius: 16px; }
      .story__title { font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 6vw, 2.2rem); margin-bottom: 16px; }
      .story__text { font-size: 0.95rem; line-height: 1.75; }

      /* Values — maroon card sized to fit the section. The old rules here
         targeted a dead .value-card class from a previous markup version
         that no longer matches anything; the real card (.value-single) was
         quietly rendering at full desktop size on mobile as a result. */
      .values { padding: 20px 20px 8px; }
      .value-single { height: 160px; padding: 18px 18px 32px; border-radius: 16px; }
      .value-slide { top: 18px; left: 18px; right: 18px; }
      .value-card__icon { font-size: 1.1rem; margin-bottom: 6px; }
      .value-card__title { font-size: 1.1rem; margin-bottom: 4px; }
      .value-card__text { font-size: 0.76rem; line-height: 1.5; }
      .value-dots { bottom: 12px; }

      /* Team section — compact so label, title, cards and hint fit the section.
         overflow: hidden clips the title's translateX reveal animation, which
         otherwise widens the layout viewport and shifts the whole page off-center. */
      .team-section { padding: 28px 20px; overflow: hidden; }
      .team-section__label { font-size: 0.6rem; letter-spacing: 4px; margin-bottom: 8px; }
      .team-section__title { font-size: clamp(1.7rem, 7vw, 2.1rem); margin-bottom: 24px; }
      .team-grid { gap: 16px; }
      .team-card { width: 130px; }
      .team-card__photo { width: 96px; height: 96px; margin: 0 auto 10px; }
      .team-card__photo--initial { font-size: 1.9rem; }
      .team-card .team-card__name { font-size: 1.05rem; margin-bottom: 4px; }
      .team-card__role { font-size: 0.6rem; letter-spacing: 1.5px; }
      .team-hint-single { font-size: 0.6rem; margin-top: 14px; }

      /* Popup — liquid glass at 49.99% so the photo backdrop shows through */
      .team-popup { padding: 60px 24px 36px; width: calc(100vw - 32px); min-height: 400px; background: linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(120,15,15,0.4999) 0%, rgba(20,5,5,0.4999) 100%); }
      .team-popup::before { background: rgba(20,5,5,0.4999); }
      .team-popup__close { top: 12px; left: 50%; right: auto; transform: translateX(-50%); background: none; backdrop-filter: none; -webkit-backdrop-filter: none; }
      .team-popup__name { font-size: 1.6rem; }

      /* CTA — removed on mobile */
      .about-cta { display: none; }

      /* Footer below main (z2) so the team popup overlay paints above it;
         still above the video scrim (z1, earlier in DOM) */
      .footer-min { z-index: 1; }
      .about-cta__title { font-size: 0.9rem; letter-spacing: -0.2px; margin-bottom: 28px; }
      .about-cta__sub { font-size: 0.78rem; margin-bottom: 18px; }
      .about-cta__btn { padding: 10px 24px; font-size: 0.7rem; letter-spacing: 2px; }
    }

    /* ===== SMALLEST PHONES (≤375px) — iPhone SE, Galaxy A-series ===== */
    @media (max-width: 375px) {
      .about-hero { padding: 90px 16px 40px; }
      .story { padding: 32px 16px; }
      .values { padding: 28px 16px; }
      .value-card { padding: 22px 16px; }
      .team-section { padding: 28px 16px; }
      .team-card { width: 120px; }
      .team-card__photo { width: 90px; height: 90px; }
      .team-card__photo--initial { font-size: 1.7rem; }
      .about-cta { margin: 16px 12px 48px; padding: 28px 16px; }
    }
